summary: The portable Issue #85 evidence package passes its local publication gates. A fresh hash-bound build and the latest strict actual-model matrix pass on one RTX 4070 Laptop GPU: all 151936 same-input final-head logits are finite and exact at thresholds max_abs<=0.001, RMSE<=0.0001, cosine>=0.999999, with 6/6 GPU outputs byte-identical. This is not global model parity, a speed or device-loss recovery claim, 4K evidence, release readiness, or a default promotion. The true remaining release gates are two independent reviews of the exact staged digest followed by Auto Research and repository CI on the final revision; performance characterization and actual-kernel/device-loss testing are nongating limitations or future work.

current_final_source.binding: The final-provenance bundle records a successful fresh build, complete stdout/stderr/exit-code records, unchanged source/model hashes, fresh driver SHA-256 ae5e4b5c76bab37bf43a0ff67bf61cf9b57c8ff97e39abdac47b2a1059ba561f, and the latest strict acceptance report SHA-256 0cba74521a13cabf3c1003385e5865a413784c813f59e804c92f186b25f98d7c.
current_final_source.claim_limit: This binds the local build and strict same-input final-head matrix to exact source/model/driver bytes. It does not bind a staged digest, commit, pushed revision, release CI run, global model parity, speed, or 4K behavior.

current_runtime_memory.scope_limit: This is a repeated same-process native final-head functional/memory gate on the actual model. It records no latency distribution and supports no speedup or sustained-generation throughput claim. Shared-device cudaMemGetInfo samples are not a general leak proof.

current_fault_injection.scope_limit: The launch injection is cudaGetLastError return injection after a real launch, not an actually failed device kernel. Device-loss recovery remains unproven.

result.comparison_domain: one fixed layer-47 residual from seed token 42, F32 final norm, complete Q6_K output.weight head

historical_actual_model_all_logit.scope_limit: Historical same-input final-head evidence only. It is not evidence that the current fixed-v2 source reran the all-logit gate and does not establish global model, residual, multi-token, semantic, or 4K parity.

result.comparison_domain: one fixed layer-47 residual from seed token 42, F32 final norm, complete Q6_K output.weight head

current_strict_actual_model_all_logit.scope_limit: Current exact-byte same-input final-head evidence only; no global model, residual, multi-token, semantic, speed, 4K, or release-readiness claim.

build_and_runtime.cuda_toolchain_scope: user-local installation; not a repository dependency and not a global machine configuration
build_and_runtime.runtime_path_requirement: Prepend the user-local CUDA bin directory to PATH only for the CUDA-linked process/session; do not mutate global PATH.
build_and_runtime.default_execution: CPU-only build and F32 activation remain the defaults; CUDA final-head execution requires both the CUDA build and explicit --cuda-policy final-head-f32.

current-source repeated same-process native final-head runtime and bounded memory

passed.note: Suites overlap and are not summed.

remaining_gates.gate: two independent reviews of the exact staged digest
remaining_gates.reason: The final frozen 44-file staged payload must receive two independent PASS reviews over its exact full-diff SHA-256.

remaining_gates.gate: Auto Research and repository CI on the final revision
remaining_gates.reason: After dual review, the final revision still requires the project Auto Research gate and repository CI; current local provenance does not bind a commit, pushed revision, or post-change CI run.

non_gating_limitations_and_future_work.reason: Current execution covers one NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU with compute capability 8.9. The incompatible-kernel rejection test is fail-closed coverage, not a broad supported-device matrix.

non_gating_limitations_and_future_work.item: actual device-kernel failure and device-loss recovery
non_gating_limitations_and_future_work.reason: The negative gate injects CUDA API return failures, including cudaGetLastError after a real launch; it does not create an actually failed device kernel or exercise device-loss recovery. This testing is beyond the bounded Issue #85 contract, and no recovery claim is authorized.
The issue contract explicitly marks performance as non-gating. Observed step durations are not an acceptance distribution and authorize no speedup or sustained-generation throughput claim.
Issue #84 remains open after its timed-out attempt; Issue #85 does not promote, replace, or depend on that separate gate.

portable_packaging.hash_domain_note: raw_sha256 hashes exact bytes. lf_normalized_sha256 hashes the same text after CRLF-to-LF conversion only; it is supplied to distinguish executed Windows bytes from Git/index-style LF text.
